decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch in a municipal infrastructure niche, it is still too early to read demand clearly and the option value of keeping it listed for another tender cycle likely exceeds its carrying cost.

Public waste bins fit the firm's metal-products capabilities, and despite likely competition the product is new enough that management would usually wait for more market feedback before abandoning it.

Ground sleeves for posts are a simple, adjacent fabricated-metal product with low ongoing listing cost, so real-options logic favors keeping the product on the market while demand uncertainty resolves.

Cast iron ground sleeves appear more specialized and somewhat less core than standard fabricated steel items, but after only one year the firm would still likely keep the option open unless evidence of weak sales becomes clearer.
Steel ground sleeves are closely aligned with the firm's core fabrication base and are cheap to continue offering, so management would probably retain them while learning about market uptake.
